pre_registered_success_criteria.criterion_1: Right DNa02 evoked rate increases materially above pre-induction level (> 0.10 Hz)
pre_registered_success_criteria.criterion_2: turn_right candidate strength crosses executable threshold (> 0.05)
pre_registered_success_criteria.criterion_3: Effect replicates across >= 50% of development seeds (>= 25/50)
pre_registered_success_criteria.criterion_4: Matched sham (P5) produces zero right-steering recruitment
pre_registered_success_criteria.criterion_5: Off-target whole-network rate divergence remains within +10% bound
pre_registered_success_criteria.criterion_6: Existing left tactile steering is not catastrophically degraded
pre_registered_success_criteria.criterion_7: Causal reset (Branch B) removes acquired response, proving synaptic causality
